Denis,

Thank you for sharing your experience. We are sorry that your visit did not meet your expectations, but we would like to clarify a few points.

The two fillings were completed within the scheduled one-hour appointment, according to the agreed treatment plan and our clinical protocol. There was no rushing due to another patient.

The doctor was approximately five minutes late, and we apologize for that. Regarding payment, card payment was accepted; cash was only suggested as an alternative due to temporary technical issues with the terminal.

Parking can sometimes be difficult to find due to the busy location of our clinic, although parking is available around the building.

We fully stand behind the quality of the treatment provided. We respect that experiences can differ, but we believe it is important that our future patients have an accurate picture of the service we provide.

Kind regards,
Dental clinic Filimanović.🖐️
